entries.title: Gmail and Calendar content goes from the computers that run your work too
entries.body: When another computer runs your crew's work, what a crewmate read there from Gmail and Calendar now gets the same note after 30 days. Delete Gmail and Calendar content in Settings → General replaces it there too, and its answer counts those conversations. A computer that is out of reach or not updated yet is named in the answer, and its conversations follow once it is back or updated.

picture.alt: Settings → General with the Delete Gmail and Calendar content row under Purge task data: it now replaces what the crew read on this computer and on the computers that run your work.
